building_class.nbc_subdivision: Multi-use spans retail (F), office (E), and assembly (D sky-lobby)

response.raw_brief_summary: A 30-meter-diameter circular mixed-use tower with 5 floors above ground and 1 basement (underground parking for 30 cars) in Bangalore. Ground floor hosts retail (café, gallery); floors 1–3 are office workspace; floor 4 features a sky-lobby with terrace garden. Steel-frame structure with composite slabs, full-glass curtain-wall façade, modern futuristic aesthetic, and sustainability features (rainwater harvesting, rooftop solar). Central core with 2 lifts and 1 stair.
